title: Latest Concord recording with Snookie Young
summary: A month-old Concord session with Snookie Young, Ray Brown, Ross Tompkins and Louie Bellson.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Just recently, a month ago, I did my last recording which will come out as my record under Concord Jazz label from the -- Carl Jefferson, who is in most ways responsible for the Concord Jazz Festival.
It actually started out with a thing with Snookie Young (PHONETIC) and I making making a record together.
Who else is on that label?
Let's see, it was Snookie Young and I --

Ray Brown played bass, Ross Tomkins (PHONETIC) was piano player, and Louie Bellson was the drummer. So, it would probably be Snookie Young, Marshal Royal or Marshal Royal, Snookie Young or something. Probably "and Friends."
Yes, it was recorded here. Last month, about four weeks ago, I should imagine.
